text: Long catch-up with Khadija. Her interview at the council is on 2 November 2026 and she's properly nervous about it. Her brother Tariq has offered to drive her there that morning. She's been unemployed since the call centre closed in June so it matters a lot. Remind me to text her good luck the day before, and ask how it went afterwards.
Coffee with Ryan and Isabel. They're celebrating ten years married in March 2027 and thinking Lisbon. Isabel let slip she'd love a nice film camera. Ryan's still at the bank, hates the commute.

Rin's grandad passed away last Tuesday. Funeral is Friday at 11 in Leeds, wake at the cricket club afterwards. She seemed okay on the phone but her mum is struggling a lot. Should send flowers to the house.

Kasia and Karan got engaged!! He asked on the beach in Gdansk. No date yet but they're saying summer 2027. Kasia wants a tiny wedding, Karan's mum wants 200 people. Kasia's brother Ivan is already lobbying to DJ. Congratulate them properly when I see them Sunday.
Fang got made redundant on Monday, whole team gone. She's oddly calm about it, already got two applications in. Her partner Chen is the one panicking. Check in with her next week.
Rohan had the second round at Deloitte yesterday. Thinks it went well but they said they'd let him know a week after. Ask him how it went if he hasn't said by Friday.

Anika and Isaac called it off. Wedding was meant to be 14 August 2027 but it's not happening. She's moved back in with her parents in Reading for now. Isaac has kept the dog, Biscuit. She says she's fine but cried twice over coffee. Need to ring her this weekend.
Quick one. Esme starts her new job at the hospital on 3 November. She's the new ward manager. Celebrating that evening at the Crown, I'm going.
Connor's dad died in the summer and the stone setting is 9 January 2027. He asked if I'd come. Said yes. He's still not sleeping well.

Caught up with Agnieszka (Aga) at the school gates. Her sister Zara is getting married in Krakow on 21 June 2027, whole family flying out the week before. Aga is doing the speech and is terrified. Her kids are flower girls. Zara's fiancé is Polish too, they met at the hen do of a mutual friend.

Asha didn't get the job at the museum. They gave it to an internal candidate. She was gutted but says she's applying for the archivist role at the uni instead, deadline 30 October. Don't forget to send her that contact at the library.

spans.text: send her that contact at the library

text: Ignacio and Luis have their first anniversary on Saturday. Luis is planning a surprise dinner and asked me to keep Ignacio busy that afternoon. Ignacio mentioned wanting a proper espresso machine ages ago, could tell Luis.
Graham retiring end of December after 34 years at the council. Leaving do is 19 December 2026, upstairs at the Fox. Must chip in for the collection, Jaya is sorting it.

Jaya's mum had her hip done last week, home now. Jaya is doing all the caring and looks exhausted. Her brother Rory is useless apparently, lives in Glasgow and hasn't visited. I should drop round a meal on Thursday.

Phone call with Lukas. He's got a final interview in Munich on 12 November and is flying out the night before. If it goes well they want him to start in January 2027. He's vegetarian btw, remember for the dinner.
Ava and her boyfriend split up after six years. She's staying at Caitlin's for a bit. Caitlin says she's not eating much. Remind me to take Ava out for lunch next week, somewhere quiet.
Kemal proposed to Matilda at her parents' anniversary party, which was apparently a bit of a scene. Her dad gave a speech afterwards anyway. They're thinking a registry office in spring 2027.
Ivan said his company is doing another round of redundancies, consultation meeting on the 28th. He thinks he's safe but his wife Efua is worried. He's been quietly applying elsewhere.
Nasser's interview for the head of maths job got moved to the morning of 6 November. He's prepping a sample lesson on vectors. Text him the night before.

spans.text: interview for the head of maths job

text: Ring the venue about the deposit, then sort the car insurance before Monday.

spans.text: Ring the venue about the deposit

text: Long chat with Zara after the funeral. Her aunt's ashes go to Mumbai in February 2027, Zara and her mum flying out together. She said the day itself was okay, the next day was the hard one. Her cousin Rory is coming over from Dublin to help clear the flat in December. Need to keep checking in on her.
Rin passed her probation at the agency, permanent from 1 December 2026. She's buying a bike to celebrate. Her flatmate Khadija is moving out in the new year so she's flat hunting too.
Wedding planning update from Ryan. Venue booked for 5 September 2027 at a barn near Hebden Bridge. Stag do probably the month before. He wants me as an usher. Isabel's sister Esme is maid of honour.
Isaac lost his mum on Sunday. Didn't know her well but she was lovely at the Christmas party. Funeral not set yet. Send him a card.
Karan has three interviews next week, Tues Wed and Fri. He's quite relaxed, seems to think the Friday one is the real contender. Ask him on the weekend which one he wants.

spans.text: Ask him on the weekend which one he wants

text: Kasia told me her nan turns 90 on 8 March 2027 and the family are throwing a big lunch. Kasia says she loves anything lavender.
Note to self: CV needs updating before the Barros application closes on 15 November. Mention the project at Kumar & Co.

spans.text: Mention the project at Kumar & Co

text: Met Fang's new partner Chen properly for the first time. He's a vet, very dry sense of humour. They've got a rescue greyhound called Pip. Seem very happy.
Caitlin's last day at the solicitors is Friday, she's going freelance. Drinks after work at the Ivy, I said I'd go. Her boss Mrs Williams is apparently furious.
Anika is doing much better. She's started a pottery course on Wednesdays and is thinking of applying for jobs in Bristol. Still not talking to Isaac.

spans.text: thinking of applying for jobs in Bristol

text: Connor and his wife Asha renew their vows on 20 April 2027, twenty years. Small do in the garden. Their kids are planning a slideshow and want old photos. Should dig out the ones from Cornwall.

spans.text: dig out the ones from Cornwall

text: Tariq got the job!! Starts at the airport on 10 November, nights for the first month. Khadija is so proud of him. Send congrats.

Quiet one with Rohan. His girlfriend left in September and he's only just telling people. He's thrown himself into running, half marathon in Manchester in April 2027. His flatmate Kemal says he barely leaves his room. Seems lonely. Must invite him over for food.
Esme's dog Rolo has to have a lump removed on Thursday. She's in bits about it. Text her that afternoon to see how he got on.
Graham said his son Lukas is getting married in Vancouver, October 2027. Graham's never flown long haul and is nervous. Him and his wife are going three weeks early to make a holiday of it.
Ignacio is up for promotion to senior designer, decision by the end of November. Panel interview the Tuesday before. He's been working on his portfolio every evening.
Luis's dad Uncle Nacho is in hospital after a fall. Luis is going down to Valencia on the 25th and staying a week after. Remind me to message him while he's there.
Isabel and Ryan's anniversary dinner got cancelled, Ryan's got Covid. Rebooking for December sometime. Isabel is fine, just annoyed.
Agnieszka's interview went badly. She blanked on the competency questions. They're interviewing others until 31 October so she'll hear after that. Ask her about it first week of November.
Dentist 9am Tuesday, then pick up the dry cleaning.
Kemal's grandmother died in Izmir last week. He flew out on Friday, back on the 30th. Matilda stayed here with the kids. I should check on Matilda, she's on her own with three of them.
Rory's band are playing their first gig on 14 November 2026 at the Brudenell. Jaya is going, so am I. Rory's surprisingly nervous for someone who never shuts up.
Ava has her civil service assessment centre on 4 December. Two days, she's staying in London the night before. Her boyfriend's going with her this time. Really want her to get this one.
Efua and Ivan's twins are getting christened on 22 November. Party at their house straight after. Efua says no gifts but they always say that, could get the twins something small.
Had a walk with Matilda. She's started the application for the PhD at Edinburgh, starts September 2027 if she gets in. Interview would be in February. Kemal is very supportive, he'd move up with her.

Nasser and Isaac fell out over Isaac's wedding. Nasser wasn't asked to be best man, Isaac's brother Ivan got it instead. Wedding's 3 July 2027. Nasser says he's still going but won't do the stag. Ivan seemed embarrassed about the whole thing. Don't take sides.

Caitlin's mum is retiring from nursing in March 2027 after forty years. Caitlin's planning a surprise party the weekend after. Her mum would love a garden voucher apparently. Remind me to ask Caitlin what I can bring.

spans.text: ask Caitlin what I can bring

text: Bit of a heavy chat with Isabel. Her company announced restructuring today, she'll find out if her role's at risk on 9 November. She's been sick with worry. Ryan is trying to keep things normal at home, taking her away that weekend. Their cat Miso is the only one sleeping well apparently. I should ring her the day after she finds out, whatever happens.

spans.text: find out if her role's at risk
the day after she finds out

text: Zara's engagement party is Saturday at her parents' in Croydon. She asked if I could help set up that morning. Her fiancé Karan is doing the cooking.
Ryan's sister Rin has gone vegan and is training for a triathlon. Very into wild swimming.
Shortlisted for the Popescu role! Phone interview on 29 October at 2pm. Need to read up on their supply chain stuff beforehand.

spans.text: read up on their supply chain stuff

text: Fang's father's memorial is 15 December 2026 in Singapore. She's flying out with her brother the week before and staying through New Year. It's the first one since he passed. Should get her something for the trip.

spans.text: get her something for the trip

text: Lunch with Luis, Esme and Kasia. Luis had the second interview at the theatre yesterday and thinks he aced it, they'll call him by Friday. Esme's engaged now, to Graham's nephew Connor, no date. Kasia is still job hunting after the redundancy in August, has an interview at the library on 1 November. She seemed flat. Remind me to ask Luis on Friday if they called, and to text Kasia good luck the night before hers.

spans.text: ask Luis on Friday if they called

text: Khadija's wedding anniversary is 17 November. Last year her husband forgot. She'd quite like a weekend in York this time.

spans.text: quite like a weekend in York

text: Rohan's job at the startup fell through, they pulled the offer two days before he was meant to start. He'd already handed his notice in. He's angry more than sad. Asked me to look at his CV next week.

spans.text: two days before he was meant to start

text: Asha and Connor's daughter is getting married next spring, April 2027 they think. Asha is doing the cake herself, three tiers. She's already stressing about it.
Chen got the job in Seoul. Moving out on 6 January 2027. Fang is going with him a month after once her contract ends. Leaving drinks the weekend before he goes. Need to sort a card everyone can sign.

spans.text: sort a card everyone can sign

text: Long one with Ignacio. His partner Luis was made redundant on Wednesday with almost no warning. Luis has a final meeting with HR on the 31st and Ignacio is going with him for moral support. Luis is pretending he's fine but Ignacio says he's barely sleeping. They'd booked a trip to Seville for their anniversary in November and might cancel it. I need to call Luis this weekend, and should send him that recruiter's details afterwards.
Tidying up the spare room this weekend before mum comes on the 2nd.
Agnieszka says Lukas is struggling at uni, first year, very homesick. He's coming home for reading week, 2 to 6 November. She'd like me to have a chat with him about jobs.

spans.text: have a chat with him about jobs
